sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Venomaster was used by Organization Suits under the command of Mr. Wilder in an attempt to stop the Huntik team under Dante Vale from uncovering information on Eathon Lambert but was defeated by Caliban and Raijin the Thunderbolt. [Doorway to Huntik]

Venomaster was summoned by one of Mr. Wilder's Suit to attack Dante and his team. It then fought and was defeated by Sophie's Powerbonded Sabriel. [Knight of the Willblade]

Venomaster was summoned to atttack Dante's Metagolem but was defeated when Lucas Casterwill and his team interfered. [Chasing Void]

Venomaster was used by a Suit to defeat Dante's Powerbonded Caliban. It fought along side Hoffman's Myrmidon but was defeated in combat. Later Hoffman attempted to summon Venomaster but he was stopped by Sophie Casterwill and Powerbonded Sabriel. [Zhalia's Mission]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Venomaster can spit blasts of venom from his mouth like a spitting cobra, this venom is strong enough to even melt Caliban's sword. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} He is a skilled fighter with a rattlesnake-tail blade to meet his enemies at greater distances which can whip or trip his foes {{source|Chasing Void}}{{source|Zhalia's Mission}} or disarm his enemies of their weapons from a distance. {{Source|Knight of the Willblade}} He also possesses an impressive deal of raw strength and agility, being fast enough to aptly dodge blows from [[Caliban]] {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} and [[Metagolem]]. {{source|Chasing Void}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*His summoning command is '''"Poison them."'''
*Venomaster's design is based on an Ophidean or snake man, which has turned up in popular culture every now and then. His name is a wordplay between the English words "venom" and "master". Other reptilian humanoid Titans include [[Akamaru]] and [[Unnamed Titan 011]]. 
*Venomaster seems to possess the cowl of a hooded cobra, the ability of a spitting cobra, and a sword resembling the rattle of a rattle snake, both of which are highly venomous.

full_text:
Venomaster is a cobra-like Swara-Titan that epitomizes the legends of reptile men. Carrying a resistant and flexible snake-tail whip made from his own skin, Venomaster is both an adept close combat fighter and ranged attacker, spitting cobra venom at its enemies. This Titan is commonly used by Mr. Wilder's Suits alongside Gigadrone.

==History==
Venomaster was used by Organization Suits under the command of Mr. Wilder in an attempt to stop the Huntik team under Dante Vale from uncovering information on Eathon Lambert but was defeated by Caliban and Raijin the Thunderbolt. [Doorway to Huntik]

Venomaster was summoned by one of Mr. Wilder's Suit to attack Dante and his team. It then fought and was defeated by Sophie's Powerbonded Sabriel. [Knight of the Willblade]

Venomaster was summoned to atttack Dante's Metagolem but was defeated when Lucas Casterwill and his team interfered. [Chasing Void]

Venomaster was used by a Suit to defeat Dante's Powerbonded Caliban. It fought along side Hoffman's Myrmidon but was defeated in combat. Later Hoffman attempted to summon Venomaster but he was stopped by Sophie Casterwill and Powerbonded Sabriel. [Zhalia's Mission]

==Abilities==
Venomaster can spit blasts of venom from his mouth like a spitting cobra, this venom is strong enough to even melt Caliban's sword. [Doorway to Huntik] He is a skilled fighter with a rattlesnake-tail blade to meet his enemies at greater distances which can whip or trip his foes [Chasing Void][Zhalia's Mission] or disarm his enemies of their weapons from a distance. [Knight of the Willblade] He also possesses an impressive deal of raw strength and agility, being fast enough to aptly dodge blows from Caliban [Doorway to Huntik] and Metagolem. [Chasing Void]

==Trivia==

*Venomaster's design is based on an Ophidean or snake man, which has turned up in popular culture every now and then. His name is a wordplay between the English words "venom" and "master". Other reptilian humanoid Titans include Akamaru and Unnamed Titan 011. 
*Venomaster seems to possess the cowl of a hooded cobra, the ability of a spitting cobra, and a sword resembling the rattle of a rattle snake, both of which are highly venomous.
